description: Identifies likely revenue, operations, customer experience, and trust/control bottlenecks from the supplied business context and returns a public-safe summary.

aiIdea.description: Optional AI or automation idea the user is considering.

businessContext.description: Short description of the business model, customers, offer, team, and operating context.

currentProblem.description: Main problem or bottleneck the user suspects.

currentWorkflow.description: Current workflow steps, handoffs, tools, and review points.

customerComplaints.description: Known customer complaints, friction points, refunds, or support issues.

metrics.description: Known metrics such as response time, conversion, close rate, cycle time, churn, cost, or error rate.

riskConcerns.description: Concerns about customer trust, brand risk, money, privacy, compliance, or quality control.

teamPainPoints.description: Internal pain points such as repetitive work, slow handoffs, rework, or unclear ownership.

name: identify_bottlenecks

bottleneckSummary.description: Concise public-safe summary of the most important bottlenecks.

confidence.description: Confidence level based on the clarity and completeness of the provided business context.

customerExperienceBottlenecks.description: Likely issues that create customer friction, unclear expectations, slow responses, or inconsistent service.

missingInformation.description: Information the user should provide to improve diagnostic confidence.

mostLikelyRootCause.description: Most likely underlying cause connecting the visible bottlenecks.

operationalBottlenecks.description: Likely issues that slow delivery, increase manual work, create rework, or reduce efficiency.

revenueBottlenecks.description: Likely issues that reduce sales, conversion, qualified calls, deal speed, or revenue growth.

trustControlBottlenecks.description: Likely gaps in review rules, approvals, escalation triggers, data boundaries, or quality control.

title: Identify Bottlenecks
